english.toefl: 5.0 for tests on or after January 21, 2026; 92 for earlier tests
english.note: Graduate School standards; qualifying English-language education can satisfy the requirement. Lower scores may be admitted for in-person programs with program approval and an arrival English assessment. Scores must be within two years of enrollment.

applicationFee.note: International applicants pay an additional $6 processing fee. Graduate School fee grants are restricted to U.S. citizens/permanent residents; no unrestricted program waiver offer was confirmed.

funding.note: Assistantships and fellowships are available to qualified students. International applicants should note that a teaching assistantship is not normally possible in the first year.
